newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Celesc maintained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Celesc maintained.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it was maintaining its accumulate rating for Santa Catarina state's power utility Celesc.
-- It said in a report "Celesc is a pure distribution company but is currently engaged in a strong investment program into generation, which we view as favorable."

-- But Merrill Lynch noted that Celesc's tariffs are lower than the average of the major distributors in the country, "which is the most important reason for the below average margins attained by the company."
-- Celesc preferred shares were off 1.66 percent at 1.18 reais in afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
